name: health-clip-thai
description: Make short Thai health and medical explainer clips end to end: topic ideas, real PubMed evidence, cited spoken-Thai script, 2D-cartoon video prompts, TTS-ready script and SRT subtitles, Thai voiceover with free Google Gemini TTS (female Leda / male Puck), then a finished 1080p MP4 (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5) with code-drawn animation, ASS Thai subtitles, synthesized music and an animated logo ring, a 2-slide carousel (PNG) and a caption with PubMed references, plus a small subagent team.
